case_number: 2024 INSC 13; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO.  OF 2024 (arising out of Special Leave Petition (Criminal) No. 863 of 2019)

parties.respondent: State, Rep. By Inspector Of Police

summary: Conviction for murder under IPC s.302 and destruction of evidence under IPC s.201; recovery of corpse parts from sump and canal based on disclosure statement; hostile witnesses; property dispute motive; co-accused acquitted; life imprisonment for murder upheld while destruction of evidence sentence set aside due to alternative charge conviction; superimposition test confirmed identity; disclosure statement under Evidence Act ss.27 & 8 admissible; final disposal of appeals arising from FIR No.80/2008.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed in part; conviction under s.302 upheld with life imprisonment; conviction under s.201 set aside; life imprisonment and fine maintained; s.201 sentence quashed due to alternative charge principle.
